thread:
erin.k: Heads up — spotted a high-severity vuln in a transitive dep used by our oauth service: tokenlib v0.9.7 (CVE-2026-1432). PoC attached in the advisory.
samir.patel: link? need quick triage. is this remote exploitable?
erin.k: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-1432 — it’s a crypto misuse in tokenlib that can allow token forging when KMS is misconfigured. Exploit requires ability to craft tokens to the service endpoint (so public exposure matters).
leah-ops: affected surfaces: hosted API, Dedicated control plane, and Private if customers haven't enforced KMS key usage for token signing. Might be limited for customers with HSM-backed signing enforced.
caleb-devex: do we have a list of customers using the old token path vs new KMS-backed path? can we map by tenant config?
erin.k: yes — running query now, but quick numbers: ~95% hosted traffic uses new KMS path, ~70% of Dedicated pools still on local-signing shim, and a handful of Private installs (4 customers) explicitly disabled KMS for legacy reasons.
ops-bot: Query complete. hosted_legacy_count=120 tenants, dedicated_legacy_count=8 tenants, private_legacy_customers=[acme-corp, globex]
samir.patel: Risk matrix: hosted legacy tenants are public-facing => high exposure. Dedicated legacy customers are internal namespaced — SLA impact moderate because they have reserved capacity and we can't force-restart without notice.
leah-ops: recommended triage actions: 1) patch tokenlib in our oauth service and auth-proxy, 2) add runtime check to deny tokens signed with local keys if KMS is enforceable, 3) push advisory/CC to affected customers.
erin.k: Agreed. Need to decide rollout cadence: emergency hotfix vs staged rollout. If we do emergency force restart it may violate Dedicated customer maintenance windows.
caleb-devex: propose: Hosted => immediate emergency patch with 30m canary (10% traffic) then 2-hr ramp. Dedicated => schedule rolling patch during each customer's configured maintenance window this week, offer hotpatch if they opt-in. Private => contact clients and provide patch bundle + instructions.
samir.patel: SLA impact: Hosted emergency patch may cause 1–3 min token refresh hiccups for some sessions. Our SLA for hosted is 99.9% uptime but we have incident allowances for infra updates. Need comms ready.
leah-ops: Also consider backporting to oauth v1.8.x we still support for some Dedicated clusters. Will add backport PRs to patch branch.
erin.k: Who owns emergency deploy? I can lead hosted canary patch if infra signs off.
caleb-devex: I can prepare PRs and changelog + tests. @ops-bot can you create canary job and monitor error-rate and token-failure logs? Use these alerts: auth.token.fail_rate, auth.signature.mismatch.
ops-bot: Canary job created: canary_job_id=canary-18425-01. Alerts wired to eng-oncall and eng-security. Will post status every 5m.
samir.patel: Communication template: short security notice + required actions. For Dedicated/Private, include remediation steps and offer assisted patching. Draft below:
```
We identified CVE-2026-1432 affecting tokenlib v0.9.7 which may allow token forging when local signing keys are used. Redwood recommends enabling KMS-backed signing or applying the security patch (v0.9.8). Hosted customers: we will apply a staged emergency patch starting Thu 02:00 UTC; expect short-lived token refreshes. Dedicated/Private: schedule via your maintenance window; contact support if you want an assisted patch.
```
erin.k: Good. Timeline proposal: Hosted canary Thu 02:00 UTC, ramp Thu 03:00 UTC full roll by 05:00 UTC. Dedicated rolling updates Thu-Fri per customer windows. Private clients notified today EOD with patch bundle.
leah-ops: Approve but add rollback plan: if signature mismatch rate > 0.5% for 15m, automatically rollback. Also keep a hotfix branch for quick reverts.
caleb-devex: Tests added: unit test for token validation, integration test against KMS emulator, and end-to-end smoke in staging. PR created: https://git.redwood/shipping/pull/4021
samir.patel: One more: coordinate with support to classify customers by tier and prepare templated emails. Hosted high-usage customers flagged for personal outreach.
erin.k: I'll open incident #INC-2026-1432 for tracking and post updates. Assigning tasks: erin.k -> lead hosted deploy; caleb-devex -> PRs/backports; leah-ops -> rollout scheduling + rollback rules; samir.patel -> comms & customer outreach.
ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-1432. Slack channel #incident-18425 created and linked. Monitoring started.
caleb-devex: Note: we should include KMS key-rotation verification in postmortem; some Private installs rotated keys manually which prevented easy mitigation. Add to checklist.
erin.k: Agreed. OK let's proceed with the proposed timeline. I'll post hourly updates in #incident-18425 once canary starts. :thumbsup:
